messages:
Irene F: detection alert — found GCS archive with Vault sealed blobs in partner bucket: gs://partner-exports/redwood/2026-03-22/sealed-export.tar.gz
Noah B: metadata + uploader? which KMS wrap key?
Irene F: uploader=partner-sync-sa@partner-prod ; wrap key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ext-kr/cryptoKeys/ext-wrap-hsm
oncall-bot: ALERT: sealed-blob-external-upload by partner-sync-sa (rule: sealed-blob-gcs)
Carmen S: immediate: 1) revoke decrypt binding, 2) copy to sec-quarantine, 3) snapshot KMS & Vault audit, 4) token accessor sweep. I'll run 1-2.
Irene F: running:
```
gsutil cp gs://partner-exports/redwood/2026-03-22/sealed-export.tar.gz gs://sec-quarantine/partner-sealed-2026-03-22.tar.gz
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy ext-wrap-hsm --location=global --keyring=ext-kr > /tmp/ext-policy-before.json
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding ext-wrap-hsm --location=global --keyring=ext-kr --member="serviceAccount:partner-sync-sa@partner-prod" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
```
Carmen S: quarantine copy done; IAM snapshot saved to gs://ops/audit/ext-policy-before-3845007777.json
Noah B: open incident INC-2026-181, notify Legal and PartnerOps. plan: canary rewrap (25 objects), rotate key version, rewrap legit blobs, add onboarding CI gate to block direct cryptoKeyDecrypter grants.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-181 assigned to Carmen S, Noah B (severity: medium)
Irene F: partner paused export job; they confirm accidental staging dump. scheduling postmortem 2026-03-23 16:00. closing thread, moving tracking to incident. :white_check_mark:
